A '''spaceport''' was located in a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Raxus Secundus/Legends|Raxus Secundus]]. The [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] was guarded by multiple battle droids, mostly [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s and was the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] that [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] flew to, to meet a separatist senator and good friend of Padmé's, [[Mina Bonteri/Legends|Mina Bonteri]].
